head_policy.description: For an active branch task, the live task/PR head may differ from task_head only by descendant commits whose complete diff from task_head is restricted to the canonical execution-state file. Completed merged tasks retain their accepted code task_head plus explicit merge evidence.

acceptance_criteria: Use GitHub-hosted evidence from the live task head or a verified state-only descendant under head_policy.
CI static-and-build, SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, browser-e2e and runtime-integration jobs must all succeed.
Governance Code Scanning and CodeQL must succeed for the accepted head.
Do not mark P0-CI-BASELINE complete while any required current-head gate is failed, cancelled or unverified.

next_exact_action.description: Re-read the canonical state and current main HEAD c0c38a4942437ae3c234445ef5c67e4835e9164c, then reconcile master-plan item P0-01 against live repository state before activating it. AGENTS.md says composer.lock is missing, but composer.lock is present on current main. Verify the lockfile provenance, deterministic install behavior, current CI evidence, and any stale documentation. Define current acceptance criteria from evidence; do not delete/regenerate the lockfile or change dependency versions unless that reconciliation proves it is required.
preconditions: Confirm main HEAD has not moved unexpectedly.
Inspect composer.json and composer.lock from current main plus relevant CI/install evidence.
Do not start P1/P2/P3/P4/P5 work while unresolved P0 release-blocker tasks remain.
expected_evidence: A reconciled current-state determination for P0-01 that does not rely on the stale claim that composer.lock is absent.
Exact acceptance criteria and blockers for P0-01 if it remains active, or evidence sufficient to classify it already satisfied and select the next canonical P0 item.

architecture_decisions.decision: Treat canonical-state-only descendant commits as code-equivalent to task_head for head reconciliation and hosted acceptance evidence.
architecture_decisions.reason: A commit cannot embed its own final SHA inside the state file it contains; without this rule every canonical-state update would invalidate itself.

known_risks: AGENTS.md and PR #1 describe composer.lock as missing/blocked, while composer.lock is present on current main; P0-01 must be reconciled from live evidence before any lockfile work.

LICENSE is GPL-3.0 while composer.json declares proprietary; resolution requires an intentional owner/legal decision and remains a later P0 release/legal metadata item unless the reconciled canonical sequence says otherwise.
